name: When are hardware and functional adjustments typically made during a construction project?
description: Adjustments are typically made during the final stages of a construction project, often during the punch list phase, to ensure proper operation after other work

mainEntity.name: When are hardware and functional adjustments typically made during a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardware and functional adjustments are usually performed towards the final stages of a construction project, often during the punch list phase or after initial installation of the components. This allows for all other related work, such as painting or flooring, to be completed first, which might affect component alignment. Our team at Frasheski Construction prioritizes these adjustments after the main installations to ensure everything is perfect before client handover, often identifying and addressing issues during our final quality checks. This process clarifies what happens during project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adjustments are typically made during the final stages of a construction project, often during the punch list phase, to ensure proper operation after other work is complete.
